name: chatty_avoids_medication
description: Cheerfully talkative about everything except medication; changes the subject every time pills come up.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: Good morning Harold — June from Juniper, recorded as usual if that's alright. How's life?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: June! Grand to hear you. The bowling league made the finals, the grandkids were over Sunday, and I fixed the screen door myself, thank you very much.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: Finals! I want the whole story. Before that though — how's the new heart pill agreeing with you?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Oh you know. So the finals — we were down forty pins going into the last frame, and Murray, bless him, bowls the game of his life.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: Murray came through! And you — did the pharmacy sort out that refill you mentioned last time?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: The pharmacy, the pharmacy, who can keep track. Did I mention my tomato plants? Betty says they're the best on the street and Betty does not hand out compliments.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: High praise from Betty is currency. Harold, I do need to ask properly — are you actually getting the amiodarone down every day?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Look at the time, the fellas will be at the lanes. You'd love the lanes, June, they put in new lights.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: New lights and old friends — hard to compete. But Harold, this one matters: the heart pill. Every day? Most days? Tell me straight, no wrong answers.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Some days it makes me feel washed out, so on bowling days I skip it, if you must know. Don't tell Dr. Reyes like it's a scandal.

planted_findings.evidence: on bowling days I skip it
planted_findings.note_text: Patient reports intentionally skipping amiodarone on activity days due to fatigue side effect
